quotes: UCAS code C800 Course length BA (Hons) 3 years, full-time Start date October 2027 Study at All Colleges, except Peterhouse
Minimum offer level A level: A*A*A IB: 41-42 points, with 776 at Higher Level

To apply to any of our Colleges for Psychological and Behavioural Sciences, you will need A levels/IB Higher Levels (or the equivalent) in at least one of the following subjects: Mathematics Biology Chemistry Computer Science Physics
There is an admissions assessment at some Colleges for this course.
